visual_density.note: Captions plus keywords alone read as too plain. Proposals include a concrete illustration plan (licensed images in Illustration cards, Points cards timed to the speech, clip transitions at section changes) and state what the renderer cannot do yet. Still a proposal for approval, not an automatic layer.

cut_policy.status: Confirmed default after input-001 feedback (08/11/2026): 'cắt gắt quá, cắt cả vào từ khác, cần thừa thật lâu hoặc khoảng trống lớn mới cắt'.
cut_policy.remove: Propose a cut only for a long redundant stretch (a restart, repeated question or filler phrase of about 1 s or more) or a large pause (about 0.8 s or more, shortened rather than removed). Leave short fillers, brief hesitations and pauses under 0.8 s in the video.
cut_policy.edges: Every cut edge must fall in real silence; keep about 0.15 s of pause beside the kept words. A redundant stretch that runs straight into kept speech is kept, or its edge moves to the nearest real pause when the words dropped still read well (say so in the proposal). Cut between syllables only when the user asks for that specific cut.
cut_policy.tool: ai_editor.py cut (and cut --studio for the Studio draft) enforces the edges: --pad 0.15, --min-remove 0.5, edges move through at most 0.1 s of sound; skipped ranges are reported. A transition at a section change without a removal uses --split in a pause.

tiktok_layout.status: Confirmed default for talking-head TikTok edits (input-001, 08/11/2026). Propose it as the layout; the user may still change it per video.
tiktok_layout.title: Fixed two-line title for the whole video at the top, about y 225-435 on 1080x1920: Be Vietnam Pro Bold about 76 px, line 1 dark navy #14344A, line 2 red #C02126, white outline, no box. Offer three title wordings from the transcript in the proposal. Render with scripts/render_text.py --second-color.
tiktok_layout.motion: Illustrations and cards full width and opaque (fill: true; x 0, y 0, 1080 wide, about 1000 high, CTA cards shorter), listed after the title so they cover it while shown; keep them above the speaker's eyes.
tiktok_layout.long_info: Long information (a list of 3 or more points, or text the viewer must read for about 8 s or more) uses a full-screen opaque Points card (1080x1920, fill: true, up to 6 points); its text sits between the TikTok header and the bottom captions, which stay readable on top.
tiktok_layout.captions: Speech captions at the bottom: bottom edge about y 1600 (margin_v about 320 at 1080x1920), just above TikTok's caption and username rows. Check the mouth and chin on the real face position; balanced two-line items.
tiktok_layout.sound: No sound effect when an illustration or card appears (user, 08/11/2026). A whoosh only on clip transitions, under the voice (gain about 0.35, loudest point on the cut); licensed files only.
tiktok_layout.apps: When the speech names an app or platform (e.g. a Zalo community room), show its official, unmodified app icon (App Store listing) in the card.
